text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (She truly is strong...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The immense pressure from Oguri and the 
others kept me from running the race the 
way I wanted...!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Miss, Oguri...—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Will you be running in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...That is my intention. And—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And so, I will defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Gladly. Let's race, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Leaving me behind in the dust— just what 
do you think you're doing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inari-san—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I'm running in the next 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) too. And so is Creek.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The Eternal Big Three, all gathered in 
one place...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha! What a great expression! You're 
surprisingly easy to read, aren'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a once-in-a-lifetime festival. I'll 
be looking forward to it. See ya, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It seems heaven's fortune is on our side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The Eternal Big Three, all gathered 
together. This is a situation beyond what 
we could have ever hoped for.
choice_data_list: We'll have to rethink our strategy.
We'll need to rethink our strategy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us give it everything we have and 
face the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And... we will definitely win!

"Upon whom will history—the 'now'—smile? 
The moment that would reveal the answer 
was fast approaching—"
